title: Kristina's Editing Space
summary: I provide tailored editorial services for indie authors, specializing in Developmental Editing and Proofreading for both fiction and creative non-fiction. My goal is to help your writing shine, achieving your publishing ambitions.

title: Covers by Nadia
summary: Illustrated and typography-driven cover design for YA and fantasy. Packages include a full wraparound for print and a matching e-book cover.

title: WordWeave Formatting
summary: Clean, consistent e-book and print formatting using Vellum or Atticus, including drop caps, scene breaks, and front/back matter.

title: Indie Ad Collective
summary: Amazon and Facebook ad management for self-published authors, plus newsletter swap coordination to build an engaged mailing list.

title: Narrated by Theo
summary: Warm, versatile male narration for fiction and nonfiction audiobooks, ACX-distributed with royalty share or per-finished-hour options.

title: Lingua Indie Translations
summary: Literary translation into Spanish and French by a two-person team with a background in genre fiction, including localized idioms and cultural notes.
